topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: Well, isn't this just perfect. After all the fuss about keeping quiet and the hints dropped like subtle breadcrumbs, now it turns out there won't even be a party. All that effort, keeping my lips sealed, playing along with the charade, and for what? To find out it’s all off? I suppose I should feel relieved to skip the social pretenses and the forced laughter, but instead, I’m just left with a room full of unused decorations and an evening with nothing to do. Typical, really. Just when I thought something might break the monotony.
